video_caption: The video opens with a woman with long dark hair, wearing a light blue collared shirt, smiling subtly at a man whose face is mostly out of frame; a diamond tiara graphic with the text "Impressive" is at the bottom left. The scene then cuts to Wendy Williams, a woman with long blonde hair, dressed in a red suit, sitting on a purple armchair in a studio with multiple screens behind her displaying an image of Prince Harry and Meghan Markle holding hands outdoors, while she gestures animatedly. Text reading "Wendy11" appears on the screens, and a mug labeled "Wendy" sits on a table next to her, signifying her show. Subsequently, the video shows an audience member, a woman with dark, curly hair wearing a black top and leather jacket, looking to her right with a displeased expression. The scene transitions back to Meghan Markle, now wearing a beige sleeveless trench dress, standing on a lawn and conversing with a man in a blue shirt, with trees and a building in the background. Finally, the segment concludes with a formal image of Prince Harry in a dark suit and Meghan Markle in a white coat, both smiling and waving on a green lawn. The "Impressive" text overlay remains throughout the video.

The video segment opens with a close-up of Meghan Markle smiling, her dark hair parted in the middle and flowing around her face, set against a blurred background. A logo "EMPRESSIVE" featuring a sparkling crown is visible in the bottom left corner, and text "ITV/Harry & Meghan: An African Journey" (ITV/Harry & Meghan: An African Journey) appears at the top left, indicating the source of the footage. Meghan then appears outdoors in a sleeveless, light-colored trench dress, speaking with a serious expression to a man in a light blue shirt, with lush greenery in the background. The scene transitions to Meghan, wearing an olive green collared shirt and a purple flower in her hair, holding hands with Prince Harry, who is in a light-colored suit jacket and white shirt; both are smiling and walking amidst a crowd. Another shot shows Meghan, in a blue long-sleeved dress, and Prince Harry, in a light suit, walking on a street alongside another woman in a white dress. Quickly, the video shows Prince Harry embracing a young child with Meghan nearby, followed by Meghan holding a baby, presumably Archie, while Prince Harry stands beside them in a dark suit. The segment concludes with Meghan, dressed in a dark green shirt with a delicate necklace, and Prince Harry, in a light gray suit jacket over a white shirt, sitting side-by-side, both smiling widely at the camera, with blurred figures in the background. Throughout these various scenes, the "EMPRESSIVE" logo remains in the bottom left corner.

The video presents a montage of Meghan Markle and Prince Harry, beginning with the couple walking hand-in-hand, both smiling; Meghan, visibly pregnant, wears a white dress and coat, while Harry is in a dark suit with a light pink tie. This transitions to Meghan speaking during an outdoor interview, wearing a light-colored jacket and green earrings, with her dark hair pulled back. During this segment, on-screen text reads "ITV Exclusive: This Sunday, 9pm," indicating a television program. Meghan appears thoughtful and at times emotional as she speaks, occasionally gesturing with her right hand. The video then cuts to a still photograph of Meghan and Harry holding their newborn baby, all three smiling; Meghan wears a white sleeveless top, and Harry a light grey suit. Another brief shot shows Meghan looking intently at Harry in an outdoor setting, both dressed in smart casual attire, with green foliage in the background. The video repeatedly returns to close-ups of Meghan in the interview, showing her expressions ranging from a gentle smile to a more somber, reflective look as she continues to speak.

The video segment opens with a black and white close-up of Meghan Markle, seen from the chest up, looking slightly upwards and to the right with a gentle smile. Her dark hair is styled down, and she wears small earrings. The background is blurred, showing what appears to be trees or foliage. In the bottom left corner, a pink logo with a stylized crown and the word "Empressive" is displayed. In the bottom right corner, white text reads "ITV Exclusive: This Sunday, 9pm". At the 0:06 mark, the scene transitions to a composite image. On the left, a blurred, black and white image of Prince Harry in military uniform is visible, looking downwards. On the right, a color image of Meghan Markle in a white wedding dress and veil, holding a bouquet, looks directly at the camera with a serious expression. Overlaid in the center, between these two figures, is another black and white image of Meghan Markle, appearing to be crying, with a hand wiping a tear from her face. The "Empressive" logo and "ITV Exclusive: This Sunday, 9pm" text remain present in their respective corners.

The video segment opens with a close-up of Meghan Markle and Prince Harry holding hands and walking. Meghan, on the right, is wearing a white off-the-shoulder wedding dress with a long veil and a sparkling tiara, smiling slightly and looking towards the camera. Prince Harry, on the left, is in a dark military uniform with medals, looking down. The background is dark, with some foliage visible. The logo "Empressive" (written with a stylized crown and diamonds) is visible in the bottom left corner. The scene then transitions to Meghan and Harry walking outdoors, both smiling broadly. Meghan is now wearing a blue collared dress with a tied waist, and Harry is in a light beige suit jacket over a white shirt. They are holding hands, with blurred people and structures in the background, suggesting a public event. The "Empressive" logo remains in the bottom left corner.

The video opens with a still image of Meghan Markle and her father, overlaid with the sparkling purple text "Hot TOPICS" and a white crown logo featuring "Empressive Wendy11" at the bottom left. The scene transitions to Wendy Williams, a woman with long blonde hair, wearing a red pantsuit and a black lace top, sitting in a large red armchair on a television set. She holds a white mug that says "wendy" and gestures as she speaks, with a blue-lit background displaying "Hot TOPICS." The background visuals intermittently change to show various images of Meghan Markle and Prince Harry, including a picture of them holding hands, which is accompanied by the on-screen text "MEGHAN's Friendly Warning!". Another image shows them smiling while holding their baby Archie. A black and white video clip of Meghan Markle in a trench coat, being interviewed outdoors, is also shown, with the text "ITV / Harry & Meghan: An African Journey" (ITV / Harry & Meghan: An African Journey). This clip later appears in color. Throughout Wendy's monologue, where she asserts Meghan knew what she was doing and shouldn't garner sympathy, audience members are shown reacting with serious or confused expressions. The video concludes with close-up still images of Meghan Markle smiling, first in a beige trench coat, then in her white wedding dress with a tiara and veil, and finally in a vibrant purple dress. The "Empressive Wendy11" logo remains visible throughout the segment.

The video opens with a blurred overlay of Meghan Markle smiling over Prince Harry, followed by a close-up of Meghan Markle's face, smiling with light pink lipstick and visible freckles, wearing a light-colored coat over a white top, with a blurred green and white background. The scene then transitions to a studio setting where a woman with long blonde hair, wearing a bright red suit, sits in a purple armchair, gesturing with her hands while speaking. Behind her are two large screens; the left screen displays Meghan Markle and Prince Harry holding hands and walking, and the right screen shows Prince Harry alone, looking to the side. The text "Wendy11" is visible on the lower right screen, and an "Empressive" logo with a crown is consistently displayed in the bottom left corner throughout these segments. The video then transitions to a clear shot of Meghan Markle and Prince Harry standing together against a plain light blue background; Meghan is on the left, smiling broadly with her dark hair flowing, and Prince Harry is on the right, wearing a light blue shirt and dark blazer.

The video segment opens with a smiling Meghan Markle in a dark top and Prince Harry in a suit, walking against a blurry green background, followed by a close-up of Meghan smiling in a white collared shirt with red earrings. The scene transitions to a brightly lit TV studio where Wendy Williams, a Black woman with long blonde hair wearing a red jumpsuit, sits in a purple armchair, talking and gesturing. Behind her, a large screen displays a smiling Meghan Markle in a turquoise top. A blonde woman in a grey blazer walks towards the center of the stage, gesturing, with a man in a hat and another man in a suit visible in the blurred background. A close-up shows the blonde woman talking animatedly. The video then shows Meghan Markle smiling and waving, wearing a white shirt and butterfly earrings, followed by a shot of Kate Middleton in a red coat and beret walking with Meghan Markle in a black coat and hat, both smiling. Next, Meghan Markle speaks at a podium, gesturing expressively, while Prince Harry stands behind her, looking on. The blonde woman from the studio is shown again, talking and gesturing excitedly. Wendy Williams is then seen in her armchair, with a photo of a blonde woman holding a plaque on the screen behind her, before it switches back to Meghan Markle on the screen. The segment concludes with a shot of the studio audience, comprised of diverse adults, clapping and smiling. Throughout the video, a pink tiara icon with the text "Empressive" (meaning "Empressive") is visible in the bottom left corner, and the text "Wendy11" (meaning "Wendy11") appears periodically in the studio scenes.

The video features a woman with long wavy blonde hair in several emotional moments. The first shot shows her smiling slightly, looking directly at the camera, in front of a white background with logos for "UMC URBAN MOVIE CHANNEL" and "THE HUNTER FOUN" (likely Foundation). This transitions to a close-up of her with a serious, slightly sad expression against a solid red background. Next, she is seen inside a car at night, talking to a man in the driver's seat. She starts to cry, wiping her eyes, while explaining, "I'm so glad I have a very full life that I really enjoy. Please don't make me cry. Oh my God. I didn't plan on this but it is what it is." The final scene shows her sitting in a studio, wearing a black t-shirt, answering questions into a microphone. She becomes visibly distressed and emotional when asked about her last name, stating, "No, my name is Wendy Hunter. That's my son's name. And you can't take away... Don't make me cry," as she appears to be holding back tears. Throughout the video, a "EMPRESSIVE" logo with a crown icon is present in the bottom left corner, and logos like "ET" and "SPLASHNEWS.COM" (in the car scene) and "((SiriusXM)) URBAN VIEW" (in the studio scene) are also visible.

The video opens with a woman with long blonde hair, wearing a black shirt, appearing distressed and speaking into a microphone with a SiriusXM logo visible in the background (0:00-0:05). The scene transitions with an overlay of the previous image onto a new one showing a woman with dark hair in sunglasses and a straw hat making a peace sign and pouting, next to a bald man with sunglasses, both appearing to be on a beach (0:05-0:10). This then changes to the same man and woman, both smiling and looking happy, standing indoors against a blurry purple and blue background (0:10-0:14). The woman, now with blonde hair, is then seen on a stage in a black button-down shirt and pants, speaking and gesturing to a seated audience, with "Wendy10" visible on some chairs (0:14-0:22). The video concludes with a close-up of a woman with dark hair pulled back, wearing a light-colored top, looking upward with a slight smile, and text at the bottom reads "ITV Exclusive: This Sunday, 9pm" (0:22-0:26).

The video segment features close-up shots of Meghan Markle, with the "Empressive" logo (a tiara with the text "Empressive") consistently displayed in the bottom left corner of all frames. The first shot (0:00-0:10) shows her from the chest up, with her dark hair pulled back loosely with some strands framing her face. She has light makeup, visible freckles, and a gentle, thoughtful smile, looking upwards and slightly to the right, while wearing a dark green collared shirt against a blurred background. The scene then transitions (0:10-0:14) to a different shot where her dark, wavy hair is down and parted in the middle, and she wears a black top or jacket. Her expression is more serious and focused, as she looks straight ahead against a blurred, light-colored background. A final transition (0:14-0:20) presents her again with her dark, wavy hair down, wearing a grey top, and looking intently over her left shoulder towards the viewer with a serious, slightly concerned, or thoughtful expression. This final shot is set indoors, with a blurry background that includes a framed picture and a vertical light strip on the right.

The video begins with Megan Thee Stallion, a woman with long reddish-purple hair, wearing an orange top in what appears to be a hot tub, speaking and gesturing with her right hand. The scene then transitions to her looking into a mirror and applying makeup to her face while wearing a light yellow and white patterned top. Interspersed with these shots is a close-up of a man with dark, curly hair and a beard, wearing a white shirt with blue stripes and a gold chain, looking down and touching his hair against a light blue background. As Megan applies her makeup, text overlays resembling Instagram and Twitter comments appear, depicting a spat between Megan and her makeup artist, Akilaface. The first comment, from "akilaface," states "Makeup By Akilaface," to which "theestallion" (Megan) replies "@akilaface and me." A subsequent comment from "akilaface" to Megan reads: "@theestallion no you filled in your eyebrows and put on your lighter Mac powder when I was done. This is not a makeup war I always do your makeup and never get credited. That is hurtful." Megan responds: "@akilaface woah. First of all if you was really “hurt” you could’ve txt me this. Second you right it ain’t a war bc we all kno I do my makeup and you touch it up or I let you start it and I’ll finish it." The video concludes with a split screen: on the left, Megan, in a dark tank top, takes a mirror selfie while adjusting her hair, with a blurred man in the background. On the right, the makeup artist directly addresses the camera, looking serious, overlaid with a semi-transparent text box from his Instagram story stating: "I did this makeup and Megan touched up her eyebrows and put her Mac powder on her face like she does everytime I do her face."

The video segment features a series of Instagram story posts and a split-screen interview. It begins with an Instagram story by "akilaface" (0:02) showing text that reads: "I did this makeup and Megan touched up her eyebrows and put her Mac powder on her face like she does everytime I do her face." (Meaning: The makeup artist asserts they did the primary makeup, but Megan augmented it with her own eyebrow touch-ups and Mac powder, a routine Megan reportedly follows whenever this artist does her makeup). Below this text, a small embedded video shows a woman, presumably Megan Thee Stallion, applying powder to her face while looking into a mirror. The story then transitions to another slide from "akilaface" (0:08), displaying bold text: "All Artist Should Be Paid & Tagged. Especially when you're talented. End of Discussion." (Meaning: The makeup artist is making a firm statement about the importance of artists being compensated and credited, implying a grievance related to their recent work). Both Instagram slides are superimposed on a sparkling, abstract background with green, purple, and yellow light streaks, and a "Empressive" watermark is visible in the bottom-left corner. From 0:15, the screen transitions to a split view. On the left, a woman with long, dark, wavy hair, wearing a dark tank top and sporting long nails, is seen taking mirror selfies with a purple phone, striking different poses by touching her hair. This woman is likely Megan Thee Stallion. On the right, a man with short, curly dark hair and a beard, wearing a dark t-shirt and an earring, is captured in a close-up, speaking directly to the camera, likely the makeup artist Akilaface. The "Empressive" watermark remains on both sides of the split screen.

The video opens with a split screen: on the left, a woman with long dark hair, wearing a black top and long light-colored nails, takes a mirror selfie with a purple phone; on the right, a man with short dark curly hair and a beard, wearing a black t-shirt and a silver hoop earring, talks directly to the camera with a serious expression. The "EMPRESSIVE" logo with a crown icon is visible in the bottom left corner. The scene then transitions to a mirrored image of the woman from the left, now with elaborate makeup, including purple glittery eyeshadow, strong eyeliner, and a glossy lip, wearing a light blue and white sweater with multiple chunky silver chain necklaces. Her hair is long and straight, parted down the middle. She makes various hand gestures while speaking. A text overlay appears on the screen, reading: "akilaface @theestallion no you filled in your eyebrows and put on your lighter Mac powder when I was done. This is not a makeup war I always do your makeup and never get credited. That is hurtful" (This text implies a makeup artist, akilaface, is publicly accusing Megan Thee Stallion of taking credit for her makeup while only doing minor touch-ups herself, expressing hurt over not being credited). Another text overlay then appears, still on the mirrored image of the woman, with an additional Instagram post featuring Megan Thee Stallion in a pink sequined bikini top and matching shorts, striking a pose. The text on this overlay reads: "akilaface Many people don't know but me & Megan will literally sit up and collaborate on her face sometimes. She's still a young woman who loves her makeup and loves to play in it. So some times I will do all the makeup, some times she will and sometimes we collab. I’m just grateful she chose me as her makeup artist 💅🏽 my beautiful Stalli! Makeup by @akilaface & @theestallion Shot by @emiliocoochie" (This text, presumably from a different post by akilaface, provides a more nuanced perspective, acknowledging Megan's involvement in her own makeup application and expressing gratitude for being her chosen artist, which seemingly contradicts the previous, more critical post).

The video opens with a split screen showing Megan Thee Stallion on the left in a light-colored top, moving her head and looking around, while an Instagram post from her makeup artist, @akilaface, is displayed on the right. The post thanks Megan for choosing him and mentions their collaborative makeup process, concluding with "my beautiful Stalli!" The scene then transitions to a new split screen, featuring Megan in the same light top on the left, now sitting at a table in what appears to be a restaurant or bar, and Akilaface on the right, smiling while holding a small puppy on a set of steps. A female voice-over criticizes Akilaface for being unprofessional, stating that Megan, as his client, is not obligated to tag him every time, even though artists seek credit for business. The video then shows visual evidence that Megan has credited Akilaface before, displaying an Instagram post from @theestallion tagging @akilaface on her face in a picture with dark blue hair and red eyeshadow, captioned "Today at Bootycon." This is followed by a clip of Megan in a Vogue interview, where she says, "I like Akil (Alikaface) a lot," and then humorously discusses their makeup interactions. The video concludes with several glamorous shots of Megan Thee Stallion in different outfits and hairstyles, including one with long black hair and a bejeweled choker, another in a black leather top on a stage, and a final image featuring long white hair with red bangs, against a pink background with "PRETTYLITTLETHING.COM" logos and unicorn graphics. Throughout these concluding shots, a thumbs-up emoji and a "Subscribe" button are overlaid on the screen.
